name: E12-T10 Auth0 login and private workspace
registrationState: local definition prepared; no remote journey or test run created because Replay QA authentication is unavailable
setup: Use the frozen candidate with its complete hosted runtime, loopback published patched Durable Streams provider, separate dedicated TLS fixture issuer and empty private fixture store.
Use Ada, Grace, and an independent Ada witness browser context. These are dedicated fixture identities; never use the actual production operator credentials.

Run locally behind the configured managed Replay QA tunnel when authenticated. Current availability receipt records CLI authentication required. The explicit fallback is captured Playwright MP4, pointer/keyboard timeline, console/page/network interrogation and independently replayed fixture dumps.

steps.action: Open the anonymous app and follow Sign in to the dedicated issuer; authenticate Ada with a local next=/settings/cli-tokens return.
steps.expect: S256 authorization-code callback returns to CLI settings; Auth0/private mode and exact full source identity are visible; initial identity DOM cursor/digest match the captured snapshot.

steps.action: Return home, use Add workspace, enter browser-ada, and submit.
steps.expect: Empty initial store creates only Ada's organization; agents are off and no default agent is seeded.

steps.action: In Grace's separate browser, sign in and create browser-grace.
steps.expect: A separate private workspace is available to Grace; owners and membership are distinct.

steps.action: Ada creates welcome channel and posts acceptance text with pointer/send; Ada witness follows the channel independently.
steps.expect: Both pages show exact equal chat application offset and independently replayed digest, with the synthetic message.

steps.action: Grace and an anonymous context request Ada's private chat.
steps.expect: 401/403/404 refusal; no private response body; HTTP stream evidence separately proves read/write/follow refusal leaves heads unchanged.

steps.action: Disconnect the witness, post a second synthetic message using Enter, reconnect.
steps.expect: Witness catches up with both messages; exact DOM offset/digest equals independently replayed event prefix.
Agents-off indication and human-member interaction are reachable; agent seed controls and agent creation form absent.

steps.action: Use Account → CLI tokens. Hide secret output before capture, mint a dedicated fixture grant, then revoke it.
steps.expect: Grant format is opaque ef_cli_; secret value never retained in video/network evidence; listing and removal work; identity cursor/digest match complete independently replayed snapshots.

steps.action: Submit native logout form, then try the previous session.
steps.expect: Returns to anonymous page; previous session receives401.

steps.action: Disconnect active pages, perform a controlled fixture runtime/provider restart, retain contexts, reopen witness.
steps.expect: Active login and both synthetic messages survive; before/after identity and chat event bytes match; DOM offsets/digests match independent replay.

steps.action: Sign Ada back in and return to welcome.
steps.expect: Existing organization/messages remain and both profiles converge; no local proof route is used; zero console errors, page errors or failed requests.

errorAndRemovalPaths: HTTP companion exercises stolen/wrong/expired/reused browser-bound transactions; nonce/audience/signature/unverified-email failures; interrupted login after restart; exact canonical origin/redirect policy.

The journey exercises denied private reads, explicit grant revocation, logout, disconnection and reconnect. HTTP companion covers agent/integration refusal, missing/corrupt config/assets/key/authority store, oversize/deadline and raw/admin/fixture routes.
This fixture journey does not establish actual Auth0 operator login. That claim requires separate minimal redacted deployed-origin login/mutation/restart evidence.
